takes place on a large farm plain surrounded by hills, a cliff and large patches of farmland. In the background, a large stone bridge can be seen. On the farm, there is a green wooden two story house and a red wooden barn. There are also 4 green houses, two water tanks, a water tower, a well, a mailbox and a board set on the property. A green car, red truck and red tractor can be found on the farm. Multiple trees, rocks, red barrels, cable reels and hay bales are also scattered across the map.

The path starts at a cave, goes around the water tower and truck, around the water tanks and then goes straight into the barn.

took place on a large farm plain with gentle hills. In the background, another farm could be seen. Separating the main farm and far farm were wheatfields with hay bales. On the main farm, multiple farm barns and farmhouses could be seen. Various water tanks and grain silos could be seen. Small scale grainfields, fences and hay bales could also be seen. Several birch and oak trees could be seen.

The brown pebble path begins at a cave and ends at a barn.
is identical to the first version, except terrain water surrounded the map, instead of baseplate water.

took place a farming island in the middle of the ocean. Green fields could be seen across the map. Barns, wheatfields, hay bales, silos, windmills and trees could also be seen across the map. There were also hill mounds to place cliff towers on.

The path started at a cave and ended at a barn. It took a roughly circular path around the map.
